title: reckon-host
description: A host: a machine named by telemetry. The STIX common properties come from the STIX 2.1 core schema, so this schema lists only the ones it constrains.

hostname.description: The short host name. A host with one is identified by it.

fqdn.description: The fully qualified name, when the source gave one.

domain.description: The domain the host is in.

source_ids.description: The device id, keyed by the source tool that gave it.

device_uid.description: The device id, when no source tool names it, or on a host identified by it.

source_tool.description: The source tool a host identified by its device id came from.

weak.description: True when the host is identified by its MAC or device id rather than its name.
